about: In the year 22XX, fragments from a meteorite that crash-landed on Earth lead to the discovery of a mysterious new mineral known as Force Metal.
Advancements made possible through the application of Force Metal revolutionize Reploid engineering, and a massive artificial island known as Giga City is constructed to mine its valuable ore.
At first, operations on the island appear to be running smoothly...
But one day, a group of Reploids on the island arm themselves, declare themselves the Rebellion, and rise up against the authorities.
The government identifies their leader, Epsilon, as a Maverick and dispatches an elite team of Maverick Hunters to Giga City.
And so, on the colossal artificial island of Giga City, X’s fierce battle begins.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
